EMERGENCY PROCEDURES:

STRUCTURAL COLLAPSE:

1. Clear the area immediately - evacuate to assembly point

2. Account for all personnel - conduct head count

3. Call 911 - advise of collapse and potential trapped workers

4. DO NOT re-enter structure - wait for emergency services

5. Secure the perimeter - prevent unauthorized access

FIRE/EXPLOSION:

1. Sound alarm - evacuate immediately

2. Call 911 - provide location and nature of fire

3. If safe, use fire extinguishers on small fires

4. Account for all personnel at assembly point

5. Isolate fuel/power sources if safe to do so

MEDICAL EMERGENCY:

1. Assess scene safety - DO NOT become victim

2. Call 911 - provide location and nature of injury

3. Provide first aid/CPR if trained

4. Direct emergency responders to scene

5. Complete incident report

HAZARDOUS MATERIALS RELEASE:

1. Evacuate affected area - upwind if possible

2. Call 911 - identify material if known

3. Notify site supervisor immediately

4. Isolate area - restrict access

5. Contact environmental authorities if required
